loops.description: Main dev loop: preflight → pick issue → implement → verify → commit → PR. Bug issues auto-approve and merge; everything else waits for human review.

tasks.name: Preflight: clean tree + sync main
commandArgs: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && git switch main && git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

tasks.name: Recovery: dirty tree, reset and return to main
commandArgs: git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch main && git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

tasks.name: Select and reserve oldest code:pick issue
commandArgs: number=$(gh issue list --label "code:pick" --state open --limit 1000 --json number --jq "sort_by(.number) | .[0].number"); test -n "$number" || exit 75; body=$(gh issue view "$number" --json number,title,body --jq "{number,title,body}"); gh issue edit "$number" --add-label code:doing --remove-label code:pick >/dev/null; printf "%s\n" "$body"

tasks.name: Implement: opencode /plan-goal
commandArgs: First, load all skills available for your current agent. Then run: git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main. If there are conflicts, resolve them preferring the incoming main changes. Then complete all remaining work for this issue. Inspect the current repository state. If there is an unfinished OpenSpec change, partial implementation, or failing validation related to this issue, continue and finish that work. If no related work exists, execute /plan-goal to plan and implement the issue. Before finishing, run pnpm typecheck and fix any errors. Preserve correct existing work. Work on a feature branch. Never explore or read files outside the current repository root. Do not push or perform any GitHub actions. Never ask for confirmation. Archive the completed change and generate visual evidence. Issue title: {{title}} Issue body: {{body}} Issue id: {{number}}

tasks.name: Verify: openspec clean + typecheck + tests
commandArgs: openspec list --json | python3 -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if len(data.get('changes',[]))==0 else 1)" && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

tasks.name: Stage and commit all changes
commandArgs: git add -A && git commit -m "fix: resolve #{{number}} {{title}}" || true

tasks.name: Create PR and squash merge (auto-admin)
commandArgs: BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current) && git push -u origin "$BRANCH" >/dev/null && PR_URL=$(gh pr create --title "Resolve #{{number}}: {{title}}" --body "Closes #{{number}}" --label code:done) && gh pr merge "$PR_URL" --squash --delete-branch --admin && printf '{"prUrl":"%s"}\n' "$PR_URL"

tasks.name: Complete: close issue and return to main
commandArgs: gh issue edit {{number}} --add-label code:done --remove-label code:doing --remove-label code:review && gh issue close {{number}} && git checkout -- . && git clean -fd && git switch main

tasks.name: Recovery: retry merge with admin, then leave for review
commandArgs: BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$BRANCH" ] && [ "$BRANCH" != "main" ]; then   PR_URL=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json url --jq ".[0].url" 2>/dev/null);   if [ -n "$PR_URL" ]; then     gh pr merge "$PR_URL" --squash --delete-branch --admin && exit 0;   fi; fi; gh issue edit {{number}} --add-label code:review --remove-label code:doing && git checkout -- . && git clean -fd && git switch main

tasks.name: Recovery: reset hard + relabel issue back to pick
commandArgs: git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch main && gh issue edit {{number}} --add-label code:pick --remove-label code:doing

tasks.name: No tasks to pick
commandArgs: Nothing to do, no issues with code:pick label
